newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Clothes, shoes boost Swedish July retail sales.
newsitem.headline: Clothes, shoes boost Swedish July retail sales.

text.p: Sales of textiles, clothes and shoes fuelled a 2.7 percent rise in Sweden's July retail sales, Statistics Sweden said on Wednesday.
This sector of retail trade rose by 9.3 percent in July compared to July 1995, the bureau said.
Sales of goods in specialised sales including clothing, furniture and secondhand goods stores increased by 6.9 percent.
Sales in the sector which included department stores and other non-specialised stores with food rose by only 1.8 percent.
Statistics Sweden said earlier on Wedenesday that Sweden's retail sales rose 2.7 percent in July for a year-on-year fall of 0.3 percent.
